atlassianJqlTheWatcherPollsThis: Atlassian JQL. The watcher polls this query and creates one task per newly-matching ticket.
capOnOpenTasksCreatedBy: Cap on open tasks created by this watcher. Leave blank for no cap. New matches are deferred to the next poll when the cap is reached.
customJqlOverridePillFiltersAre: Custom JQL override — pill filters are paused.
enterAPositiveIntegerOrLeave: Enter a positive integer or leave blank.
howOftenToReRunThe: How often to re-run the JQL. Minimum 60s, maximum 3600s.
jqlIsGeneratedFromThePills: JQL is generated from the pills above. Edit to override.
label: Label
noJiraWatchersConfiguredCreateOne: No JIRA watchers configured. Create one to auto-create tasks from JQL queries.
pollAJqlQueryAndAuto: Poll a JQL query and auto-create a Kandev task for each newly-matching ticket. Optionally bind a repository so each task runs against that codebase, or leave it unset to run with no repository.
saveCurrentFiltersAsAView: Save current filters as a view
savedLeaveBlankToKeepThe: (saved — leave blank to keep the current value)
